Comment: Runs pulp-analytics/poster-corpus-validation's scripts/01-10 respecting the real dependency graph (01→{02,03,07,08}, 02→{04,08}, 04→{05,09}, 05→06). The 5 full-corpus-scale scripts (02,03,04,05,06) run as AWS Batch array jobs, each array child self-selecting its shard via AWS_BATCH_JOB_ARRAY_INDEX, followed by a MergeShards step; 01/07/08/09/Assemble process a small/bounded row count and run as single Fargate ECS tasks instead -- see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for why the split isn't uniform. Gate 16 (celebrity verification, added later) runs as a 6th independent Batch-array branch inside IndependentGates, same shape as gate 4 -- its output isn't yet consumed by Assemble, same as gate 15. NOTE: this comment and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's dependency diagram predate gates 2/4/13/14/16 and the 02-13→03-14 renumbering; the actual States below are current, the prose describing them here is not -- trust the JSON over this comment for anything not about gate 16. REPLACE_WITH_* placeholders need your own resource ids.

IndependentGates.Comment: 03, 07, and the 02-rooted branch only depend on 01's output -- none of them need each other.

DedupeMetadata.Comment: Not sharded -- 07 only checks the small set of title+year+overview duplicate CANDIDATES it finds locally first (a tiny fraction of the corpus: ~18 groups out of 145k rows in the real run), not every row, so there's no per-row throughput problem here to solve.

AfterVerify.Comment: 04 and 08 are the only two steps that download the poster image itself, so both -- and only both -- depend on 02's verified=1 result.

BedrockOCRShards.Comment: Highest-value script to shard: a Bedrock call per row, the slowest and most numerous step in a full run. Longer retry backoff than the other array jobs -- Bedrock throttling (ThrottlingException) under concurrent load across many array children is the most likely transient failure here.

AfterBedrock.Comment: 05→06 and 09 both only need the merged vision_title_check.csv -- neither needs the other's output.

CollapseCompilations.Comment: Not sharded, same reasoning as 07: only checks posters already found to be shared by 2+ ids -- a small set, not the full corpus.

FinalDedupeGrouping.Comment: Unsharded re-invocation against the merged, global --cache: every poster is already hashed (resumable skip on --cache), so this makes zero new poster downloads -- its only real job is redoing the cheap local group-by-md5 step correctly across shard boundaries (MD5 dupes can span shards, unlike gate 4/2's per-id verdicts). --tmdb-cache is intentionally a fresh path, not merged from shard tmdb-caches: completeness signals only matter for ids in a *correctly, globally* computed duplicate group, which shard-level runs couldn't know -- recomputing them here is cheap (duplicate groups are a tiny fraction of the corpus) and guarantees correctness over reusing possibly-wrong shard-level signals. See 10_dedupe_poster_md5.py's own --shard-count docstring.

PosterTypeShards.Comment: Gate 4, shardable like gate 6 (a Bedrock/Rekognition call per zero-OCR poster). No real dependency on gate 3's verified output -- fetches poster_path itself, same as gate 6. Per-shard output has no --rescue-out (that's computed once, after merging, below).

BuildRescueList.Comment: Re-invokes gate 4 against the now-merged --out: every id is already done (resumable skip), so this makes zero new Bedrock/Rekognition calls -- its only real job is the --rescue-out side effect (filter the merged results to is_movie_poster=False), which needs the FULL merged file, not a single shard's slice.

VerifyCelebritiesShards.Comment: Gate 16: same shape as gate 4 (a Bedrock + Rekognition call per row), no dependency on any other gate's output -- fetches poster_path itself from $.prunedIdsPath, same as gates 4/6.

MergeVerifyCelebrities.Comment: Not yet consumed by Assemble (12_validate_corpus.py --assemble-only has no --celebrity-path flag) -- same as gate 15's content_moderation.csv, this is a flagged-for-review output, not an automatic exclusion signal. See poster-corpus-validation's docs/VALIDATION_GATES.md, Gate 16.

Assemble.Comment: Only reads the files every branch above already wrote -- 10_validate_corpus.py --assemble-only.

FindAlternatePosters.Comment: Gate 4's rescue, gate 13 half -- --in is gate 4's --rescue-out (is_movie_poster=False only, same scope as the Python orchestrator's version of this rescue).

BuildPruneList.Comment: Unsharded re-invocation against the merged --out: every id is already judged (resumable skip), so this makes zero new TMDB external_ids calls -- its only real job is the --prune-out side effect, which needs the FULL merged verdict set, not a single shard's slice. Same pattern as gate 4's BuildRescueList.

FetchAdultTconsts.Comment: Refreshes gate 2's pre-filtered isAdult=1 tconst list from $.adultTconstsBucket/$.adultTconstsKey (see scripts/prep_adult_tconsts.py and docs/AWS_SETUP.md, 'Gate 2 reference data' for how to build and publish your own copy -- this is NOT bundled in the image or repo, every deployment points at its own bucket) onto EFS (small, ~1MB gzipped -- see scripts/prep_adult_tconsts.py) so FilterIsAdultShards' array children each load a small local file instead of every shard decompressing and scanning the full ~200MB title.basics.tsv.gz snapshot. Not a --prune-out-style resumable step -- always re-fetched, since it's cheap and this keeps the reference data fresh if smoketest/adult_tconsts_isadult1.csv.gz is ever regenerated.
